# @nagp/recipe-ui

Reusable **StencilJS** web component library for the
[Recipe Finder & Meal Planner](../README.md) app. These are framework-agnostic
custom elements — this package builds and publishes them, and they're consumed
by the `sveltekit-app` package in this repo (or any other framework/vanilla JS).

## Components

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `rc-recipe-card` | Recipe summary card — props for id/name/image/category/favorite state, `favoriteToggle`/`cardSelect` events, named `actions` slot for host buttons (Edit/Delete). |
| `rc-search-bar` | Search input with `searchInput`/`searchSubmit` events; default slot for filter controls. |
| `rc-star-rating` | Interactive star rating control, emits `ratingChange`. |
| `rc-photo-carousel` | Simple image carousel for recipe photos. |

Each component's full prop/event/slot reference is auto-generated by Stencil's
docs target and lives in its own folder, e.g.
[`src/components/rc-recipe-card/readme.md`](./src/components/rc-recipe-card/readme.md).

## Getting started

Requires Node 18+.

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

This produces `dist/` (including the `dist-custom-elements` build the app
consumes) and `loader/`. See the [root README](../README.md#setup-instructions)
for how this fits together with `sveltekit-app`.

Other useful commands:

```bash
npm start   # dev build with watch + local dev server
npm test    # unit tests
```

## Using these components

The app in this repo imports components individually from the
`dist-custom-elements` output (not Stencil's lazy loader — see the
[root README](../README.md#a-real-integration-bug-worth-knowing-about) for why):

```ts
import '@nagp/recipe-ui/rc-recipe-card';
```

```html
<rc-recipe-card
  recipe-id="52772"
  name="Teriyaki Chicken Casserole"
  image="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
  category="Chicken"
  is-favorite="true"
></rc-recipe-card>
```

Custom events (`favoriteToggle`, `cardSelect`, `ratingChange`, `searchSubmit`,
`searchInput`) are plain `CustomEvent`s and can be listened to the standard way,
or via `on<EventName>` props in frameworks that support it (Svelte, React, etc.).

## Publishing

Ships as a scoped npm package (`@nagp/recipe-ui`). See the
[root README's npm publishing section](../README.md#npm-publishing) for the full
steps (replacing the `@nagp` placeholder, `npm publish`, versioning).
